method_evidence.claim: Using a unified MLLM achieves better performance than specialized single-modality encoders for T2A and V2A.
method_evidence.anchor: the results consistently demonstrate the superiority of using a unified MLLM, which achieves significantly better performance across all metrics in both tasks.

experiment_evidence.claim: Audio-Omni achieves competitive or superior human evaluation ratings across all tasks.
Audio-Omni achieves FAD 1.86 on T2A, FAD 1.41 on T2M, FAD 1.71 on V2A, FAD 1.51 on V2M.
Audio-Omni achieves average FAD 3.27 and LSD 2.27 on audio editing tasks.
